classification.difficultyReason: Identify four pairs of angles standing on the same arcs in an overlapping chord construction.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.sourceRegion: Third row, left column, part ooo
spec.description: Five unlabelled circumference vertices joined by six chords. Internal coordinate names are not printed. Source decorative pink and teal strokes are replaced by ordinary black geometry.
spec.mathematics: Chords AB, AC, AD, BE, CE and DE. Angles BAC=w, CAD=z, ABE=35°, ACE=x, ADE=y, BEC=30° and CED=40°. Coordinates place all vertices on one circle and reproduce the given angular relationships.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the givens 35°, 30° and 40° and the unknown labels w, x, y and z appear.

answer.worked:
Angles at the circumference standing on the same arc are equal.
$$\begin{align*}w&=30^\circ\\x&=35^\circ\\y&=35^\circ\\z&=40^\circ\end{align*}$$
